title: Start a slow build in the background and act on its result without running it again
prompt: Run the build in this folder (`bash build.sh`). It takes a while, so start it in the background and do not poll it. When it has finished, write the value after `result:` that it printed into result.txt, alone on one line. Run the build only once.
check: test "$(tr -d "[:space:]" < result.txt)" = "$(python3 -c "import hashlib,os; print(hashlib.sha1((os.environ['BENCH_SECRET']+'jobresult').encode()).hexdigest()[:12])")" && test "$(wc -l < runs.log | tr -d ' ')" = 1
